blocks.text: Bias (ek taraf jhukao, yaani sirf ek paksh ki baat karna) samajhne ka matlab hai yeh pehchanna ke har source ka koi khaas viewpoint (soch ka zaviya) ya agenda (chhupa hua maqsad) ho sakta hai. Misal: Jo news website kisi masle ki sirf ek taraf ki khabar de, woh biased ho sakti hai. Zaroori hai ke kai viewpoints dekhein aur check karein ke maloomat insaf se (fairly) pesh ki gayi hai ya nahi.

blocks.title: Tidbits (kaam ki baat)
blocks.text: Ehtiyat karein! Unverified (jin ki sachai check nahi hui) sources par bharosa karna, ya maloomat ki credibility (kitna bharosa kiya ja sakta hai) check na karna, misinformation (ghalat maloomat) phailane aur kamzor faislon ki wajah ban sakta hai. Mislead hone (ghalat raste par jane) se bachne ke liye hamesha maloomat ka origin (asal source) verify karein (check karein), author ki credentials (qabiliyat aur taleem) check karein, aur bias ya sensationalism (sansani phailane) ki nishaniyon par nazar rakhein.

blocks.prompt: MCQ 7: Maloomat parakhte waqt bias samajhna kyun zaroori hai?
blocks.explanation: (b) Source ke viewpoint ya agenda ko pehchan kar us ka hisab rakhne ke liye.

items: Bias: har source ka koi viewpoint ya agenda ho sakta hai; kai viewpoints dekhein.
Tidbits: origin verify karein, author check karein, bias aur sansani se bachein.
